NGEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Every post under NGEL Recruitment 2026 has its own qualification, experience and job-summary requirements. Candidates should check the post they intend to apply for carefully, since a candidate can apply for only one post among those advertised.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Civil) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering with at least 65% marks from a recognised university/institution (55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in Geotech/piling/foundation/structural steel/tower structures/switchyard, etc. Candidates with RE experience are preferred.
  • Job summary: Civil system design, technical specifications for regulatory compliance of solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management, quality assurance, equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning, and O&M of the RE station.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Electrical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electrical, Instrumentation & Control/Power Systems & High Voltage/Power Electronics/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in switchyard/electrical testing/transmission system/transformer/design/engineering. RE experience in the plant/engineering domain is preferred.
  • Job summary: Electrical system design and technical specifications for solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management for equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning and O&M.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Mechanical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Mechanical/Production/Industrial Engineering/Production & Industrial Engineering/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Preference is given to candidates with an ME/M.Tech degree.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience involving supervision/execution in power generation (Thermal/Gas/Hydro/Nuclear/Renewables). RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Design and engineering of mechanical systems for RE projects, site selection, tender documentation, AutoCAD drawings, vendor drawing approval, supervision of equipment installation and O&M, and processing of statutory compliances.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Human Resource) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Graduate with at least a 2-year full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/Programme in Management with specialisation in HR/Industrial Relations/Personnel Management, or MHROD, or MBA (HR) with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in HR functions/Industrial Relations. Knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory labour-law compliance for RE areas, recruitment and onboarding, employee benefits and compensation, site infrastructure development, CSR execution around RE sites, and land acquisition/lease payment matters.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Finance) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Qualified CA or CMA.
  • Experience: Minimum 1 year post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period) in Finance/Accounts.
  • Job summary: Vendor invoice processing and payments, statutory compliance (GST, TDS, etc.), preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements as per IndAS and SEBI LODR, statutory/internal/government audits, costing, budgeting, financial projections, resource mobilisation, working capital management and payroll accounting.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Safety) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Production/Electrical/Civil/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD) plus a full-time Diploma in Industrial Safety from a Regional Labour Institute/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules; OR a full-time Engineering Degree in Industrial Safety/Fire & Safety with at least 65% marks from a university/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules of any state.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in safety, preferably in the power or manufacturing industry (Govt./PSU or a private company of repute). Post-qualification experience is counted from the date of acquiring the engineering degree. RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory safety compliance under the Factories Act, developing/auditing/improving factory safety systems, safety-consciousness promotion, machinery/equipment/building safety inspection, emergency management planning, and organising safety and fire-fighting training and mock drills.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-CSR) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time PG Degree/Diploma/Programme in Rural Management/Rural Development/Displacement/Resettlement/Rehabilitation/Community Development/Local Governance/Local Development/Livelihoods/Social Entrepreneurship/Social Development/Social Administration/Sustainable Development/Development Policy & Practice/Development Studies, or MSW, or MBA, or a Graduate in Engineering, with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in conducting/reviewing/analysing/monitoring socio-economic surveys, stakeholder consultation through participatory tools, handling CSR activities under the Companies Act, need-assessment or social-impact-assessment surveys, or CSR project planning and implementation.
  • Job summary: Implementation of NGEL's CSR plan, drafting proposals, overseeing CSR activity execution, MIS preparation, payment processing, and handling internal and statutory CSR audits, reports and returns.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Rajbhasha) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: A Master's Degree from a recognised university in Hindi (with English as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination), or in English (with Hindi as compulsory/elective subject or medium), or in any other subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective/medium, or with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective/medium, or with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or as medium and compulsory/elective subject, at the degree level. See the official notification for the exact combination of eligible qualifications.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification experience of using/applying terminology in Hindi or translation work from English to Hindi (or vice versa), under Central/State Government, Union Territories, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, PSUs, universities, or recognised research and education institutions.
  • Job summary: Formation and coordination of the Official Language Implementation Committee, Hindi progress reports, organising Hindi Day/Fortnight and Hindi workshops, translation work (English to Hindi and vice versa), magazine editing, and implementation of Official Language Policy.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit and Relaxation

The upper age limit for all eight posts is 35 years, computed as on the last date of receipt of the online application. Age relaxation is available as per government norms:

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen: relaxation as per applicable Government guidelines

Age relaxation applies where a vacancy is identified for that particular reserved category.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Salary / CTC

As per the notification, the approximate CTC for the advertised posts is Rs 11,00,000 per annum. This is indicative and includes both fixed and variable components, House Rent Allowance (HRA), Mediclaim for self, spouse, dependent parents and two children, performance-based variable pay, and a satisfactory service grant. The notification states that actual remuneration will depend on the candidate's experience, place of posting, and other terms and conditions of appointment.

Category Fee
General / EWS / OBC Rs. 500 (non-refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (XSM) / Female candidates No fee payable

Payment can be made online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card, or UPI within the application form itself. The notification states that the fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should verify their eligibility before paying.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

NGEL may conduct a multi-stage selection process comprising application shortlisting/screening, a Computer-Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion and/or Interview, or a combination of these, and reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards if required.

If Selection is Through CBT

  • The CBT is bilingual with multiple-choice questions and has two sections: Section 1 – Subject Knowledge Test (SKT) (discipline-specific questions) and Section 2 – Aptitude Test (AT) (numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation).
  • The test has 100 questions and a duration of 2 hours.
  • There is negative marking: ¼ of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for every wrong answer.
  • Online CBT centres: Kolkata, Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Vishakhapatnam, Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, Bhopal and Raipur.
  • Shortlisted candidates from the CBT are called for an interview.

If No CBT is Conducted

Shortlisting will instead be done on the basis of age, qualification and experience, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview directly.

Experience 30 50% 50%

Additional notes on experience marking: 5 marks are awarded for meeting the minimum required experience, plus 1 additional mark for every extra year of experience, up to a maximum of 10 marks. The final offer of appointment is issued based on the candidate's relative rank in the merit list prepared from the cumulative total marks. Joining is subject to the candidate passing a medical examination at a specified government hospital and being declared medically fit.

Documents Required for NGEL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the following documents while applying online:

  1. Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/marksheet and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB must match across all documents).
  2. Engineering consolidated marksheet/transcript/all-semester marksheets showing aggregate percentage of marks, or the CA/CMA (ICWA) passing certificate, or Master's degree certificate with marksheets, as applicable.
  3. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI into a percentage.
  4. Documents related to the essential qualification (pass certificate and marksheets, mode, duration, specialisation).
  5. Documents related to any other qualification (pass certificate and marksheets).
  6. Caste/Disability certificate, for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates, as applicable.
  7. OBC-NCL certificate in the central format for financial year 2026-27.
  8. EWS candidates: current-year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27, based on FY 2025-26 income.
  9. Disability certificates as per the latest Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability for the post.
  10. Documents supporting the requisite years of post-qualification executive experience - in chronological order from the most recent organisation backward - including experience certificate, appointment/offer/joining letter, confirmation letter or training-completion order (if any), promotion order, role-assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and two payslips per year.
  11. Self-attested copies of age proof, marksheets/transcripts and certificates for all qualifications, and experience certificates from all organisations specifically mentioning area of specialisation/job performed/expertise.
  12. Candidates from Government organisations/PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to provide it within a stipulated time / obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

How to Apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026 - NGEL Apply Online

  1. Visit the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID, since NGEL will not be responsible for any bounced-back emails.
  3. Fill in the online application form and upload all required documents listed above.
  4. Pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 500 (General/EWS/OBC candidates) online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card or UPI. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and female candidates are exempt from the fee.
  5. Submit the application and download the system-generated application slip carrying a unique registration number.
  6. Retain a copy of the application slip for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

Candidates should read the full text of the advertisement and agree to all conditions before applying, and can apply for only one post out of those advertised. If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same post, the application with the higher application sequence number will be considered.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be from universities/institutions recognised and approved in India.
  • Age, experience and qualification are computed with reference to the last date of receipt of the online application.
  • Candidates claiming a reserved category must hold a valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/Disability certificate from the competent authority.
  • NGEL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process, or restrict, curtail or enlarge the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Posting can be at any Station/Project/JV/Subsidiary of NGEL, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of management.
  • If a candidate is found, at any stage (including after appointment), to not fulfil eligibility norms or to have furnished false/incorrect information or suppressed material facts, the candidature or service will be liable to cancellation/termination without notice.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • Merely submitting an application does not entitle a candidate to be called for a written test, interview, or further selection stages.
  • Candidates must undergo a medical examination at a specified government hospital before joining; the hospital's decision on medical fitness is final and binding, and no relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed.
  • Disputes arising from this advertisement or any application submitted in response to it fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals/forums at Delhi.
  • In case of any ambiguity due to translation, the English version of the advertisement will prevail.

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Where CGPA/OGPA/Letter Grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be indicated in the online application as per the norms of the concerned Board/University/Institute, with a supporting certificate furnished at document verification.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second must be in a different trade, with a minimum one-year gap between the two (subject to conditions specified in the notification for terminated contracts).
  • Candidates applying under NATS or NAPS who have completed five years in the relevant discipline (as on 31.08.2026) after acquiring the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend

The stipend payable to apprentices is governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprentices Rules, 1992, and applicable amendments/guidelines. In addition to the statutory stipend, IOCL (MD), NR will pay ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses. For Graduate and Technician Apprentices, a portion of the stipend is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). Trade Apprentices (NAPS apprentices) receive their full stipend directly from IOCL (MD), NR. These arrangements are subject to change as per government/BOAT/NAPS guidelines issued from time to time. A specific fixed monthly stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  1. Online Application: Candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal and applying against the notification are considered for selection. There is no written test or interview.
  2. Merit List: Prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the respective post. Ties are resolved first by earlier date of birth, and then by higher marks in matriculation if the date of birth is also the same.
  3. Preference: Given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time.
  4. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.
  5. Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test: Candidates must be adjudged medically fit as per IOCL's pre-engagement medical standards.
  6. Offer of Engagement: Issued to candidates who successfully clear document verification and the medical fitness test. Up to ₹3,000 is reimbursed towards expenses incurred for pre-engagement medical tests/investigations, on production of receipts.

    • Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

  3. Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003.
  4. After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c
  5. Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained.

  • Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS.

Pension New Pension Scheme
Other Benefits Medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidized canteen, limited housing (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, House Building Advance, as per Central Government orders

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Application Fee

There is a non-refundable application fee of ₹250 for all posts. However, all candidates must initially and uniformly pay ₹750 as a processing fee at the time of applying online.

Category Fee Details
All candidates (initial payment) ₹750 processing fee (uniform for all candidates)
Non-refundable application fee ₹250 (deducted from the processing fee for all posts)
Women, SC/ST/PwBD, Ex-Servicemen Full refund of the processing fee, subject to appearing in the Written Test/CBT
All other candidates ₹500 refunded after deducting the ₹250 application fee, subject to appearing in the Written Test/CBT

The application fee is collected only in online mode through the Bharatkosh e-payment gateway, using Internet Banking, Unified Payment Interface (UPI), or Domestic Debit Cards. Cash, cheque, draft, money order, or IPO payments are not accepted. Refunds will be credited to the bank account details furnished by the candidate in the application; ICRB/ISRO will not be responsible for refund issues arising from incorrect bank details entered by the candidate. Refund will not be considered if a candidate does not appear for the Written Test/CBT.

Also Read: NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 376 Posts

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Selection Process

Selection for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 is based on a Written Test/CBT followed by an Interview.

Written Test/CBT Pattern

Part Duration Question Type No. of Questions Marks Marking Scheme
Part A – Area/Discipline Specific 90 minutes Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) 80 80 +1 for each correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -1/3 for each wrong answer
Part B – Aptitude/Ability Test 30 minutes Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) on Numerical, Logical, Diagrammatic, Abstract, and Deductive Reasoning Maximum 15 20 No negative marking

The Written Test/CBT carries a total of 100 marks and will be conducted at 37 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam. ICRB reserves the right to change or cancel a test venue and reallot candidates to another centre.

Qualifying Marks in Written Test/CBT

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
Unreserved candidates 50% each in Part A and Part B
PwBD candidates (wherever posts are reserved) 40% each in Part A and Part B

Based on Written Test/CBT performance, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio, with an aggregate minimum of 10 candidates. For reserved vacancies, distinct/additional candidates are shortlisted separately in the 1:5 ratio.

Interview Assessment Criteria

Attribute Marks Allocation
Technical (Academic) Knowledge 40
General Awareness relevant to area of specialisation 20
Presentation/Communication Skill 20
Comprehension 10
Academic Achievements (institute type, academic performance, rank, if any) 10
Total 100

Final Qualifying Criteria and Panel Weightage

Category Written Test/CBT Interview Aggregate
Unreserved candidates 50% 50% 60%
PwBD candidates (wherever posts are reserved) 40% 40% 50%

For the final panel, 50% weightage is given to Written Test/CBT marks and 50% to Interview marks. In case of a tie, inter-se merit is decided in order by marks in the Written Test/CBT, marks in the essential qualification, and then date of birth (older candidates placed higher).

Documents Required

  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months) in .jpg/.jpeg format, 200 x 230 pixels, 100–200 KB
  • Signature in .jpg/.jpeg format, 140 x 60 pixels, 80–150 KB
  • SC/ST/Disability/Ex-Servicemen certificate, as applicable, for full refund of the processing fee
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, to be submitted at the time of interview, for candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies
  • PwBD Disability Certificate (self-attested, in the prescribed format, indicating percentage of disability) to be submitted at the time of interview, for PwBD-reserved posts
  • Original documents in proof of all details furnished online, to be produced at the time of interview

How to Apply for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official ISRO website, www.isro.gov.in, between 27-08-2026 and 16-09-2026.
  2. Complete the online registration and note the online Registration Number provided after registration for future reference.
  3. Fill in the online application form, ensuring the e-mail ID is entered correctly and compulsorily, as hall tickets/call letters will be sent only by e-mail.
  4. Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format and size.
  5. Upload the SC/ST/Disability/Ex-Servicemen certificate, if applicable.
  6. Pay the processing fee of ₹750 online via the Bharatkosh e-payment gateway using Internet Banking, UPI, or a Domestic Debit Card.
  7. Verify all entered details carefully before final submission of the online application.

Applications are accepted only in online mode; incomplete applications or those not conforming to the notification requirements will not be entertained. Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications for the same post — where duplicate applications are submitted, only the one against which the application fee has been received within the last date will be considered.

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Important Instructions

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Appointees are liable to be posted at any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO and may be transferred at any time based on need.
  • The number of vacancies notified is provisional; ISRO reserves the right to increase or decrease vacancies as required.
  • ICRB/ISRO reserves the absolute right not to fill the posts, without assigning any reason.
  • The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route from the city indicated in the online application to the interview venue; no TA is payable for the Written Test.
  • If any information furnished online is found false, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview and TA will not be paid.
  • Employed candidates must apply only with the knowledge and prior permission of their employer, and must submit an NOC at the time of interview; failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for interview.
  • All further communication will be sent only through the candidate's registered e-mail ID or the ISRO website; candidates should check their e-mail regularly, including spam/junk folders.
  • Legal matters arising from this recruitment fall under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised not to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.
  • In case of any ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version will be treated as final.

How to Download RBI Assistant Prelims Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI recruitment portal at rbi.org.in and go to the "Opportunities@RBI" section, or use the direct score card login link on the official results page.
  2. Click on "Current Vacancies," then locate the RBI Assistant Recruitment 2026 (Panel Year 2025) link.
  3. Open the "Marksheet of Preliminary Examination" or "Score Card" link for the Assistant post.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number in the first field.
  5. Enter your Password (this is generally your Date of Birth, in DD-MM-YY format).
  6. Type the Captcha code exactly as shown.
  7. Click the Submit button.
  8. Your score card will be displayed on the screen download and save it, or take a printout for future reference.

RBI Assistant Prelims Cut Off 2026

The category-wise and office-wise cut off marks have been released alongside the score card. Where no vacancy exists for a category at a particular office, the cut off may be shown as "-", and in some cases all qualified candidates are merit-listed rather than shortlisted against a fixed cut off.

Important Instructions

  • Verify every detail on your score card carefully, including your name, roll number, category, and marks.
  • RBI does not send score cards through email or SMS they must be downloaded manually from the official portal.
  • Compare your marks against the official category-wise cut off before assuming your qualifying status.
  • If any information on your score card appears incorrect, contact RBI through the official channels mentioned on the recruitment portal.
  • Keep a downloaded copy or printout of the score card for future reference, including for the Mains stage and beyond.
  • Start preparing for the Mains Examination immediately, focusing on sections where your sectional marks were relatively weaker.

4 Delhi / NCR

Candidates have to choose any three centres of their preference and convenience during registration. No request for a change of centre/venue/date/session will be entertained once exercised, and the Bank reserves the right to allot a candidate to a centre other than the one opted for.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

Agniveer 21 years + Actual period of service as Agniveer + 3 years
Note: Minimum age is 18 years; age is reckoned as on 01 August 2026. The maximum age limit of 45 years for Ex-Servicemen applies uniformly across all categories, including reserved categories.

IOB Security Guard Pay Scale 2026

Particulars Details
Pay Scale (Subordinate Staff Cadre) ₹19,500–665/4–22,160–830/5–26,310–990/4–30,270–1,170/3–33,780–1,345/3–37,815 (12th Bipartite Settlement)
Basic Pay Fixation Based on last drawn salary during defence service, plus emoluments as per Industry-wide Bipartite Settlement and Bank policies
Probation 6 months of active service, confirmed on successful completion
Duties include security and surveillance of Bank premises, operating security gadgets (CCTV, DFMD, HHMD, access control systems), maintaining fire alarm and fire-fighting equipment, and working in shifts including night shifts.

IOB Security Guard Selection Process 2026

Selection is in three stages: Online Objective Test, Local Language (Tamil) Test, and Physical Fitness Test.

1. Objective Type Test (Online)

Test Maximum Marks
Knowledge of English Language 20
Aptitude Test 20
Arithmetic Test 20
Psychometric Test 20
Total 80

2. Local Language Test (Tamil)

Conducted separately for a maximum of 20 marks. The overall cut-off scores for General and Reserved category candidates in the Online Test and Local Language Test will be decided by the Bank based on candidates' performance.

3. Physical Fitness Test (100 Marks)

Sub-Test Assesses Max. Score Qualifying Score
Push-Ups Upper body muscular endurance & trunk stability 30 20
Sit-Ups Core body muscle strength 30 20
1 Kilometre Run Lower body strength, anaerobic power, speed, agility 30 20
Drill Word of command, saluting, movements 10 5
Grand Total - 100 65
  • Push-Ups/Sit-Ups: 30+ reps = 30 marks, 21–29 reps = 25 marks, 15–20 reps = 20 marks, 14 or below = Fail.
  • 1 km Run: under 4 min = 30 marks, 4–5 min = 20 marks, 5–6 min = 10 marks, over 6 min = Fail.
  • Candidates must compulsorily pass each of the four Physical Fitness sub-tests with the minimum prescribed marks; only one attempt is allowed per sub-test.
  • Candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate (not older than 15 days) from a Civil Assistant Surgeon or above, prior to the Physical Fitness Test.
  • The Physical Fitness Test will be conducted at IOB Central Office, Chennai.
Selection Criteria: The final merit list is drawn by adding marks from the Objective Test, Local Language Test, and Physical Fitness Test, prepared category/reservation-wise. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for the Online Test or Physical Fitness Test.

How to Apply for IOB Security Guard Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit www.iob.bank.in, go to the "Careers" page, and open "Recruitment of Security Guards".
  2. Read the detailed advertisement carefully and click "Apply Online" for the post.
  3. Register online by clicking "Click here to Register Online"; note your Registration Number and Password sent via email/SMS.
  4. Upload your scanned photograph, signature, live photo capture, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
  5. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully; ensure names match your certificates exactly.
  6. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" and take a printout of the submitted application form for your records.
  7. Submit the application on or before 14 September 2026.
Important: Only online applications are accepted; no other mode will be entertained. If a candidate uploads more than one application, only the latest one will be considered. There is no application fee for this recruitment.

Documents Required (at Physical Fitness Test)

  • Printout of the valid Physical Fitness Test call letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof (Passport/Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter's Card)
  • Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications
  • Discharge Book

  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable (OBC certificate must carry the Non-Creamy Layer clause, valid as on 14 September 2026)

Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as valid ID proof for this process. All documents must be produced in original along with a self-attested photocopy; failure to do so may disqualify the candidate from further participation.

Important Conditions

  • Only candidates willing to work in shifts (24x7x365) should apply.
  • Pre-Examination Training is available (free of cost) for SC/ST/Minority Communities/Ex-Servicemen candidates at Chennai; travel, boarding and lodging expenses must be borne by the candidate.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Nationalised Bank roles must produce an original NOC from their employer at the time of interview/selection stage.
  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or canvassing will be disqualified and may be debarred from future Bank recruitment, in addition to facing criminal prosecution.
  • Appointment is provisional and subject to medical fitness, and satisfactory verification of character, antecedents, and caste certificates (wherever applicable).
  • No request for change of examination centre, Physical Fitness Test date, or registered email ID will be entertained.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Chennai.
  • The Bank reserves the right to change the selection procedure, cancel, or stall the recruitment process, partially or fully, at any stage.

SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Qualification

Mandatory (both posts): Graduate (any discipline) from a Government-recognized University or Institution, and Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF. The certificate must be dated on or before 31.07.2026.

Preferred: Certificate for Documentary Credit Specialists (CDCS) by LIBF, or Certificate for Specialists in Demand Guarantees (CSDG) by LIBF, or Certified Trade Finance Professional (CTFP) by ICC Academy - OR - Global Trade Certificate (GTC) by ICC Academy, Certificate in International Trade Finance (CITF) by LIBF, or Certificate in International Trade Finance (IIBF). Job Profile

JMGS-I (Maker role): Inputs trade transactions and uploads documents into banking systems, handles TI+ data entry, conducts document scrutiny before approval, and inputs screening data into relevant systems.

MMGS-II (Checker role): Conducts TI+ checking to validate transactions, performs document scrutiny, facilitates screening against sanctions and AML policies, validates regulatory compliance, and acts as an OFAC releaser.

RRB Group D Application Status: Categories Explained

Candidates can now view their updated status under three categories:

  • Provisionally Accepted: The application has been accepted on a provisional basis. It is not a final confirmation, and RRB can still cancel the candidature at any later stage if any discrepancy is found.
  • Conditionally Accepted: The application has been accepted subject to certain conditions. Candidates must check the specific conditions mentioned against their application and follow RRB's instructions.
  • Rejected: The application has been rejected, and the reason for rejection will be shown along with the status.

  4. View your status: Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted, or Rejected.

  • Candidates should refer only to official RRB websites for recruitment updates and must not rely on unauthenticated sources.
  • RRB has warned candidates to stay alert against touts who make false promises of selection in exchange for illegal consideration. The RRB recruitment process is fully computerized, and selection is based purely on merit.

How to Apply for Future Kerala PSC Recruitments (General Process)

While applications for these two specific posts have already closed, the general Kerala PSC application process is useful for candidates tracking future notifications:

  1. Register once on keralapsc.gov.in through One Time Registration (OTR).
  2. Log in with your User ID and password.
  3. Go to the relevant notification and click "Apply Now."
  4. Verify your profile details, upload a photograph as per specifications, and submit the application before the last date.
  5. Confirm your candidature (if the post is examination-based) through your OTR profile before the exam.

Required Documents

Kerala PSC typically calls for the following documents at the stage of certificate verification, once a candidate is advised from the rank list. Exact requirements vary by post and category, so always check the official notification and advice memo:

  • SSLC / equivalent certificate (proof of age and basic qualification)
  • Relevant technical qualification certificate (NTC/Diploma, as applicable to the post)
  • Community/Caste certificate, if claiming reservation
  • Non-Creamy Layer certificate, if applicable
  • Identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, or similar)
  • Admit card / hall ticket of the examination
  • Recent passport-size photograph as per PSC specifications

Also Read: PPSC SDO and SDE Interview Schedule 2026

Important Instructions

  • Objections against the Provisional Answer Key must be submitted online only through the OTR profile within 5 days of its publication this window has already closed for both exams, since the Final Answer Key is now out.
  • No further complaints against the Final Answer Key will be entertained by the Commission.
  • The Final Answer Key is used for score computation; the next stage is the publication of the rank list.
  • Always match your answers against the alpha code printed on your own OMR sheet using the wrong code will give an incorrect score estimate.
  • Keep checking the official Kerala PSC website and your OTR profile/registered mobile number for updates on the rank list.

How to Raise an Objection Against the Provisional Answer Key

  2. Click on "Raise Objection" or "Challenge Answer Key."
  3. Select the question number you wish to challenge and state your justification clearly.
  4. Upload supporting evidence a scanned page from a standard textbook, a reference journal, or another valid document.
  5. Pay the required processing fee per objection, as specified in the official notice.
  6. Submit and save the acknowledgment receipt for your records.

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 What It Is

The Compulsory Kannada Language Test is a qualifying test, not a merit-ranking exam. It applies only to candidates from the outside-Karnataka and Kalyana-Karnataka quota who have not studied or passed their qualifying examination in Kannada, or who have not cleared an equivalent Kannada test, or who have not completed SSLC-level schooling with Kannada as a first or second language. Clearing this test alone does not guarantee final selection it is a mandatory clearance step for the candidates it applies to. The 22nd August 2026 sitting covered candidates applying for the following posts:

  • Police Department CAR/DAR/KSRP/IRB/KSISF Constable posts
  • Revenue Department Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
  • Land Surveyor posts (Department of Survey Settlement and Land Records)
  • Teacher posts under Karnataka Residential Education Institutions Society (KREIS)
  • Section Officer posts under the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 Objection Process

Candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the provisional key can do so through the official KEA Provisional Answer Key Objection Portal. The window is open from 22nd August 2026 until 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon, after which no objections will be accepted.

Steps to Raise an Objection

  1. Visit the objection portal login page at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/keaobjections.
  2. Log in using your Application Number/Register Number and the first 5 characters of your name.
  3. Enter your Date of Birth.
  4. Select the examination Compulsory Kannada – 2026 (22-08-2026).
  5. Enter the captcha code and log in.
  6. Select the question number and version code you want to object to.
  7. Upload supporting documents or proof in PDF format for each objection.
  8. Pay the applicable fee of Rs. 25/- per objection and submit.

Important Instructions

  • Every objection must clearly mention the question number and version code, and must be supported by valid proof in PDF format.
  • A fee of Rs. 25/- is charged per objection raised; this fee is non-refundable.
  • Objections that do not correctly mention the question number or version code, or that lack valid supporting proof, will not be considered.
  • The decision of the subject expert committee reviewing the objections will be treated as final.
  • Objections cannot be submitted after 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon.

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes

Once the objection window closes on 24th August 2026, the subject expert committee will review all objections submitted by candidates. Based on this review, KEA will release the final answer key for the Kannada Language Test. Results will then be prepared using the final key, feeding into the overall selection process for the respective posts Police Constable, Village Administrative Officer, Land Surveyor, KREIS Teacher, and Section Officer. The exact date for the final key and result has not been officially announced yet.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

About This Role

Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on.

Who are we?

Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community.

What does a Field Officer do?

Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken.

A day in the life of a Field Officer. . .

Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. Your responsibility is to instruct the individuals to safely perform each task and monitor the work performed for the partner site before returning them to the drop off point and returning to your depot.

We are looking for individuals with various backgrounds and experience. Some desirable skills include:

  • You'll need to be able to communicate and demonstrate a range of tasks and ensure a safe environment for work teams.
  • Have a strong understanding of Occupational Health and Safety practices and their practical application.
  • Quickly build rapport in order to understand the motivations of others, identify issues and suggest courses of action appropriate to their needs.
  • Have demonstrated ability to manage conflict and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Model appropriate behaviours and attitudes to assist individuals to develop new skills and work practices.
  • Carpentry or handyman skills
  • Gardening landscaping or painting skills

Field Officers carry out a mixture of field work and office-based work, so it's important that you are able to demonstrate computer skills and written communication skills.

Transporting individuals is also a key part of the role and Field Officers will be required to drive a 12-seater bus with trailer. A full and current drivers' licence is essential for this position.

Community Work operates seven days per week and this role will be required to work on weekends. Weekend availability is required.

For More Information About The Role Please Contact

Sarah Thompson â Manager, Community Work & Partnerships on 0407 427 396 or Sarah.Thompson@justice.vic.gov.au

How To Apply

Please click the Apply button at the bottom of this advertisement. Applications should include a resume uploaded in .doc, .docx, .pdf, .txt or .rtf formats.

The Assessment Process Will Entail The Following

  • Several questions in the application form upon submitting your resume
  • A phone screen
  • An interview
  • Reference checks
  • Security checks
  • Health assessment â medical history and physical fitness components

The successful candidate will be required to undergo pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, nationally coordinated criminal history checks (NCCHC), and misconduct screening. Dependant on the role, other checks may include VicRoads checks, drivers licence checks, medical checks, Working with Children Checks, and Declaration of Private Interests (for executive and responsible officer roles).

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people are strongly encouraged to apply.

Linsco are delighted to be working alongside our client, a well-established and growing groundwork and civil engineering contractor looking to appoint an experienced Mobile Plant Fitter to join their team.

Our client predominantly operates within the residential groundworks sector, delivering roads, sewers, infrastructure, bulk earthworks and housing plot groundworks for a number of major housebuilders and developers.

This is a field-based role covering a regional operational patch, carrying out maintenance, servicing and repairs to a fleet of construction plant and equipment across multiple live sites.

The Role

  • Service, maintain and repair a range of heavy construction plant and machinery
  • Diagnose faults and carry out breakdown repairs on site
  • Work on equipment including:
    • Excavators up to 30 tonne
    • Dumpers
    • Rollers
    • Telehandlers
  • Carry out routine inspections and preventative maintenance
  • Ensure all plant is operating safely and efficiently
  • Complete maintenance records and associated paperwork
  • Liaise with site teams and plant department regarding repairs and downtime
  • Travel between operational sites across the region

Experience working on Hitachi plant would be highly beneficial.

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge and understanding of construction plant machinery
  • Previous experience working as a Plant Fitter, Mobile Plant Engineer or similar role
  • Experience working on excavators, dumpers, rollers and telehandlers
  • Understanding of site procedures and health & safety requirements
  • Ability to work independently and manage your own workload
  • Good fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure
  • Full UK driving licence
  • NVQ Level 2 or 3 in Plant Maintenance

What's on Offer

  • Home-based role covering a local/regional patch
  • Monday to Friday working hours - 7:30am to 4:30pm
  • Company van and fuel card provided
  • Stable long-term opportunity with a growing civil engineering contractor
  • Variety of work across multiple residential infrastructure projects
  • Competitive salary and package

Applications

We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.

The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing.What Youll Be DoingTechnical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring
  • Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.
  • Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.
  • Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.
Technical Support & Collaboration
  • Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.
  • Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.
  • Follow work instructions and build documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.

SHE&Q and Compliance

  • Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.

  • Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.
  • Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.

Internal Interfaces

  • Production Manager.
  • Test Engineer.

  • Automation Team.

  • Quality Team.
External Interfaces

  • Suppliers (limited)
Core Values

Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.

What Were Looking ForEssential
  • NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.
  • Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.
  • Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.
  • Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.
  • Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.
  • Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.
Desirable
  • 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.
  • Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.
  • Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.
  • First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.
  • Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.
  • Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.
  • Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.

Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.

Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential.

Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference.

Join us and be part of something bigger.
